lines.text:
If my full name's a mouthful,
just call me Mari.

Raptures, you say?
Looks like there's going to be trouble in this place as well.
There are many similarities between Eva and Nikkes.
Can I borrow that cloth for a quick sec to wipe my glasses?
It must be hard to be you.
Can I ask for a tour of the Ark later?

Are you going to just stay there?
If you stick to one spot, your life will be uneventful.
This place also has a subterranean level? How fascinating!
This place smells like oil and grass all at once.

Mari Makinami Illustrious,
at your service!

I'm not entirely sure how it's used,
but it looks intriguing!
This world is not to be underestimated.
I should take the lead sometimes!
Son of a bitch, just you wait...
Sorry, I'll be back in a second.
Is that all you've got? Come on!
I... I have nothing else to say.
Impressive. You know exactly what gift to pick out for a girl. You must be popular with the ladies.
What exciting things could happen at the party?

There are so many cute Nikkes.
It's heartbreaking to see them dragged into battle...
How would you look in this? I should choose something stylish for you.
A band or something similar would add some elegance to the banquet.
It's an evening party, and I'm the shining star!
Phew... Should I take this chance to explore the Ark?
It's poor form to bore a beauty like me, you know.
This place would be perfect for hosting a small concert.
I've seen this base so much, that I'm getting used to it.
Hmm... I wonder if it's okay to enjoy a rural life looking like this.
It's been ages since I've felt so intellectually stimulated.
Feels like I'm doing an emergency drill again.
Huh? Did you come here to offer me flowers?
A lovely gift like this really suits me, don't you think?
Nihao! Mari Makinami Illustrious, coming to you more radiant than ever!
If I did this, would it surprise you? Hehe.
You're really putting in the effort. Good job, very good job.
Girls don't dress up just to fight.
There aren't any enemies around, so let's light a campfire.
From now on, I won't be acting ladylike.
How mortifying... I suppose I have no choice but to retreat for now.
